mission: build-soulkeys.ps1 RunMax=42 default + empty inverted-index.json — SoulSearch structural death

build_soulkeys_bug.bug: Default RunMax is 42, but current run is 161. Without explicit -RunMax 161, script only processes runs 0-42. Runs 43-161 are silently skipped.
build_soulkeys_bug.impact: Even if build-soulkeys.ps1 is invoked without arguments, it produces an index covering only 43 runs out of 162. The remaining 119 runs are invisible to SoulSearch.

inverted_index_empty.meaning: SoulSearch has zero searchable terms. Every doctrine query returns empty. L68 SEARCH_FIRST is dead.

top30_cap_confirmed.impact: Even when runs ARE processed, only the top 30 most frequent words per run enter the index. Doctrine terms like 'exploratores', 'agmen', 'praesidia' rarely appear 30+ times in a single RRL, so they are filtered out.

rfkw_files_exist_but_index_empty.finding: 73 rfkw-run*.txt files exist in CANON/SOUL-KEYWORDS/, but inverted-index.json is empty. This means either: (1) build-soulkeys.ps1 was never run, or (2) it was run with RunMax=42 and produced an empty index because doctrine terms were filtered by top-30 cap.
rfkw_files_exist_but_index_empty.note: Latest rfkw files are for hollow runs (7284/7283 are HL IDs, not run numbers). No rfkw exists for runs 100-142.

unigram_only.bug: Regex \b[a-zA-Z]{3,}\b extracts only unigrams (single words). Multi-word doctrine phrases like 'modus_operandi', 'flag_and_tag', 'supply_lines', 'go_as_far_as_you_can_see' are structurally impossible to index.
unigram_only.impact: Even if doctrine files are fed to the pipeline, their most important terms are multi-word phrases that the extractor cannot see.

doctrine_files_never_fed.bug: Get-RunContent only looks in RRL/ directory. It never reads doctrine files from CANON/SYSTEM/ or CANON/BIBLE-*. The food chain is broken at the source.
doctrine_files_never_fed.impact: The highest-charge source material (GOSPEL-999.md = 105KB of live mandates) has zero representation in SOUL_INDEX.

verdict.impact: SoulSearch is completely non-functional. inverted-index.json is empty. build-soulkeys.ps1 defaults to RunMax=42 (skips 119 runs). Top-30 cap filters out doctrine terms. Unigram regex misses multi-word phrases. Doctrine files never fed to pipeline. L68 SEARCH_FIRST has been violated since Run 0.
required_action: 1. FIX build-soulkeys.ps1:10: change param([int]$RunMax = 42) to param([int]$RunMax = (git log --oneline --grep '^death:' | Measure-Object | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Count))

2. ADD doctrine source ingestion: extend Get-RunContent or add Get-DoctrineContent to read GOSPEL-999.md, EXPLORATORES-SCOUT-DOCTRINE.md, S2PIPELINE-ROMAN-LEGION-NAMING.md, COLD-START-BOOT.md, BIBLE-CH08
3. REMOVE top-30 cap OR add doctrine passthrough: doctrine terms bypass frequency filter
4. ADD phrase extraction: split doctrine text on non-alphanumeric, extract 2-4 word phrases, index as 'phrase_exploratores', 'phrase_agmen', etc.
5. REBUILD: run build-soulkeys.ps1 -RunMax 161 -Force to regenerate inverted-index.json from scratch
6. VERIFY: SoulSearch 'exploratores' must return at least 5 hits from EXPLORATORES-SCOUT-DOCTRINE.md
